how_step1_text: Only @btu.edu.ge addresses can sign up - everyone here is a verified fellow student.
how_step2_text: List something in two minutes with photos, or search what other students are selling.
how_step3_title: Meet at the university, pay cash
how_step3_text: Message the seller, meet in a public spot at the university, check the item and pay in person. No fees, no shipping, no online payments.
safety_lead: Everyone here has a verified student account, but a few habits keep every meetup safe:
safety_tip1: Meet in a public spot at the university - the library, cafeteria, or main hall.
safety_tip2: Check the item carefully before paying.
safety_tip3: Pay cash in person. Never send money in advance, to anyone, for any reason.
safety_tip4: If a listing looks like a scam, use the Report button on it - we review every report.
contact_body1: Found a problem with a listing? The fastest route is the Report button on the listing itself - every report gets reviewed.
contact_body2: For anything else - questions, ideas, or something broken - message any listing's seller if it concerns their item, or email:
strip_text: New semester is here - textbooks are moving fast.
confirm_delete_convo: Delete this conversation? It stays in the other person's inbox, and reappears here if they message you again.
banner_title: That stuff under your bed? Another student needs it.
banner_sub: Post it free in 2 minutes - meet at the university, get paid in cash. No fees, ever.
terms_intro: BTU Marketplace is a free, independent platform where verified BTU students buy and sell items directly with each other. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these terms.
terms_s1_text: You need a valid @btu.edu.ge email to register. Accounts are for individual students - don't share your login or create accounts for other people. You must be able to form a binding agreement under Georgian law to use the marketplace.
terms_s2_title: 2. We only connect buyers and sellers
terms_s2_text: The platform is a noticeboard. All deals happen in person, in cash, directly between students. We are not a party to any sale, we don't handle payments, we don't ship anything, and we don't inspect, own, or guarantee any item. Any agreement you make is strictly between you and the other student.
terms_s3_text: Only legal items you actually own and may sell. No weapons, drugs, alcohol, tobacco, counterfeit goods, stolen property, adult content, live animals, academic cheating services, or anything prohibited by Georgian law or by BTU's rules. Listings must be honest - accurate title, description, price, and photos of the real item. We may remove any listing and suspend any account at our discretion.
terms_s4_text: Be respectful. No harassment, spam, scams, or impersonation. Meet in safe public places at the university and check items before paying. Report anything suspicious with the Report button - we review every report.
terms_s5_text: The service is provided "as is," with no guarantee it will be uninterrupted or error-free. Because every transaction happens off-platform between students, we are not responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of items, the truth of listings, or the conduct of any user. Neither Business and Technology University nor the site administrator is liable for defects in an item, payment-related issues, or any other legal claim arising from a transaction. You use the marketplace and meet other students at your own risk.
terms_s6_text: This is an early-stage student project. Features may change, and the service may pause or close at any time. We may update these terms; continued use after a change means you accept the updated version. You can delete your account at any time from Settings.
terms_s7_text: This is an independent project run by a student. It is not operated, sponsored, or endorsed by Business and Technology University. "BTU" is used only to describe who the marketplace is for.
terms_contact: Questions about these terms? Get in touch:
privacy_intro: This policy explains what we collect and why. The short version: we keep only what's needed to run a student marketplace, and we never sell your data.
privacy_s1_text: Your @btu.edu.ge email and a display name (used to sign in and to show who posted a listing), your phone number (shown to a buyer only when they open your contact info on your listing), the listings and messages you create, and basic technical data like your IP address, used for security and rate-limiting. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name and email from Google to create the account.
privacy_s2_text: To run your account, show your listings, let students message each other, send you account and listing-alert emails, keep the site secure, and prevent abuse. We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it to anyone.
privacy_s3_text: Your display name appears on your listings and in chats. Your phone number and email are shown only when someone opens the contact info on one of your listings - so only share a number you're comfortable giving to a buyer. Message contents are visible to you and the student you're messaging.
privacy_s4_text: Data is stored on third-party hosting and database providers we use to run the service. We share data only with those providers, or if required by law. We keep your information for as long as your account exists.
privacy_s5_text: You can change your phone number and password, or delete your account entirely, from Settings. Deleting your account removes your profile, listings, messages, favorites, and saved searches. Saved-search alert emails stop as soon as you delete the saved search.
privacy_s6_text: The marketplace is intended for BTU students. It is not directed at children, and you should not use it if you are not a university student.
privacy_contact: Questions about your data, or want it removed? Get in touch:
